title: Condition variable
description: cond_wait releases the mutex while waiting.

input.code:
# Waiting for a flag with a condition variable (always re-check in a loop).
shared ready = 0
mutex m
condition c

thread Waiter
  LOCK m
check:
  LOAD r, ready
  JNZ r, go
  CWAIT c, m
  JMP check
go:
  PRINT waiter proceeds
  UNLOCK m

thread Setter
  LOCK m
  STORE ready, 1
  CSIGNAL c
  UNLOCK m
